description: Create an idea in the backlog and return it (starts with 0 votes, status 'new'). Link the evidence it came from with insight_id (from list_insights). product_id defaults to the primary product. Only title is required. Grow it with vote_idea, then promote_idea turns the winner into a roadmap feature.

examples.body: Several accounts asked to change status on many tasks at once.
examples.title: Bulk-edit tasks

insight_id.description: Customer insight this idea came from, from list_insights (optional; welds evidence to the idea).

product_id.description: Product to scope it to, from whoami (optional; the primary product when omitted).

title.description: Idea title (the only required field), e.g. 'Bulk-edit tasks'.

name: create_idea
title: Create Idea
